thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — runtime-prod tail latency increase detected

maria wong: Paging. Seeing 95th go from ~180ms -> ~1.8s across several runtime shards. Error rate on streaming endpoints up ~4%. Customers reporting degraded responses.

kevin s: I'm on it. Any deploys in the last 30m?

ops-rotation: no deploys recorded in the window, CI green.

jon patel: Telemetry snapshot: queue depth on runtime-shard-12 jumped to 420, inflight request count doubled, GPU utilization pushing 92% on a subset.

ashley li: Can we get top callers? Might be a noisy customer or runaway batch.

kevin s: top keys by QPS: proj-psi (30%), proj-sim (18%), proj-free (12%), internal-analytics (8%), rnd-experiments (6%). proj-psi traffic shows many long-gen requests (median seq ~3500 tokens).

maria wong: Impact assessment: paid customers seeing slow interactive latencies; free-tier experiencing 504s on streaming. No data corruption reported. CS has a few escalations.

kevin s: Proposed immediate mitigations (live):
1) Apply short-term concurrency cap per API key to protect global queue.
2) Enable "soft-evict" for very long requests (>2000 tokens) to free KV cache sooner.
3) Tighten free-tier rate limiter and reduce burst.
4) If still high, route heavy projects to dedicated pool and/or disable non-critical features that add overhead.

maria wong: I'll apply the per-key cap now. Kevin, can you flip soft-evict and Ashley take the quota tweak?

kevin s: Running:
```
PATCH /internal/runtime/config
{ "max_inflight_per_key": 16 }
```
kevin s: Applied to all runtime shards (propagation ~20s).

jon patel: Enabling eviction policy:
```
runtime.setPolicy("soft_eviction", {"token_threshold":2000, "buckets":["paid","internal","free"]})
```
jon patel: Policy enabled. Low-priority buckets will have earlier eviction decisions.

ashley li: Adjusting free tier quota:
```
/quotas update proj-free --rps 1 --burst 5
```
ashley li: Quota updated and propagated to rate-limiters. Also temporarily disabled "streaming-fallback" feature flag on prod to reduce extra connection churn.

maria wong: Observing metrics: 95p latency improved from 1.8s -> ~520ms within ~3 minutes. 504 rate dropped from 3.8% -> 0.6%. Queue depth on shard-12 down to ~75.

kevin s: GPU CPU still elevated on a few nodes; planning a traffic-shift: move 20% of proj-psi traffic to dedicated-mlpool-2 so paid service remains smooth.

jon patel: Executing routing reweight:
```
traffic-shaper set-route --from proj-psi --to dedicated-mlpool-2 --pct 20
```
jon patel: Route change applied (rolling).

maria wong: Customer impact summary for CS: paid customers largely unaffected after mitigations; free-tier saw increased errors during the peak but now mostly recovered. No request data lost. Incident ID: 2795-runtime-latency. CS notified with timeline.

ops-rotation: I'm taking handoff in ~25m for the next 2 hours. Handoff checklist: keep soft-evict enabled, monitor 95p latency and queue depth, watch max_inflight_per_key — if latency regresses, consider lowering it further to 12. Also monitor dedicated pool CPU and adjust routing if dedicated becomes overloaded.

kevin s: I'll watch routing and be ready to revert stream-fallback disable if we see throughput regressions for paid customers. If 95p stays <600ms for 15m, we'll start relaxing caps incrementally.

maria wong: Creating a quick incident note and tagging eng-runtime + product. Please add exact timestamps for each mitigation step to the incident doc.

incident-bot: Created incident channel #inc-2795-runtime-latency and linked to oncall runbook.

ashley li: One additional note: disabling streaming-fallback shaved ~7% CPU but cost ~3% measured throughput. We'll re-evaluate in the postmortem and consider a gradual re-enable with throttles.

maria wong: Handoff complete. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-rotation: ack, taking over monitoring and will escalate if anything flares up.
